__inputs.name: DS_LOKI
__inputs.label: Loki do NOTUS
__inputs.description: Fonte de dados Loki apontando para a API do NOTUS no Render

title: NOTUS · Auditoria
description: Registro de todas as requisições à API do NOTUS (RNF6): usuário, IP, data, horário, rota, resultado e tempo de resposta.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({type="audit"} | json msg="message", ip="ip", usuario="user" | line_format `{{.msg}}` | regexp `^\S+ \| (?P<metodo>[A-Z]+) (?P<rota>\S+) \| (?P<status>\d+) \| (?P<ms>\d+)ms` | __error__="" | usuario=~`(?i).*${usuario}.*` | ip=~`.*${ip}.*` | status=~`${status}` [$__range]))

sum(count_over_time({type="audit"} | json msg="message", ip="ip", usuario="user" | line_format `{{.msg}}` | regexp `^\S+ \| (?P<metodo>[A-Z]+) (?P<rota>\S+) \| (?P<status>\d+) \| (?P<ms>\d+)ms` | __error__="" | usuario=~`(?i).*${usuario}.*` | ip=~`.*${ip}.*` | status >= 400 [$__range]))

panels.title: Tempo de resposta p95 (RNF9: até 2 s)

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {type="audit"} | json msg="message", ip="ip", usuario="user" | line_format `{{.msg}}` | regexp `^\S+ \| (?P<metodo>[A-Z]+) (?P<rota>\S+) \| (?P<status>\d+) \| (?P<ms>\d+)ms` | __error__="" | usuario=~`(?i).*${usuario}.*` | ip=~`.*${ip}.*` | status=~`${status}` | unwrap ms [$__range]) by (type)

count(sum by (usuario) (count_over_time({type="audit"} | json msg="message", ip="ip", usuario="user" | line_format `{{.msg}}` | regexp `^\S+ \| (?P<metodo>[A-Z]+) (?P<rota>\S+) \| (?P<status>\d+) \| (?P<ms>\d+)ms` | __error__="" | usuario!=`anonymous` | usuario=~`(?i).*${usuario}.*` | ip=~`.*${ip}.*` | status=~`${status}` [$__range])))

sum by (status) (count_over_time({type="audit"} | json msg="message", ip="ip", usuario="user" | line_format `{{.msg}}` | regexp `^\S+ \| (?P<metodo>[A-Z]+) (?P<rota>\S+) \| (?P<status>\d+) \| (?P<ms>\d+)ms` | __error__="" | usuario=~`(?i).*${usuario}.*` | ip=~`.*${ip}.*` | status=~`${status}` [$__interval]))

topk(10, sum by (usuario) (count_over_time({type="audit"} | json msg="message", ip="ip", usuario="user" | line_format `{{.msg}}` | regexp `^\S+ \| (?P<metodo>[A-Z]+) (?P<rota>\S+) \| (?P<status>\d+) \| (?P<ms>\d+)ms` | __error__="" | usuario=~`(?i).*${usuario}.*` | ip=~`.*${ip}.*` | status=~`${status}` [$__range])))

topk(10, sum by (ip) (count_over_time({type="audit"} | json msg="message", ip="ip", usuario="user" | line_format `{{.msg}}` | regexp `^\S+ \| (?P<metodo>[A-Z]+) (?P<rota>\S+) \| (?P<status>\d+) \| (?P<ms>\d+)ms` | __error__="" | usuario=~`(?i).*${usuario}.*` | ip=~`.*${ip}.*` | status=~`${status}` [$__range])))

panels.title: Acessos negados e erros por rota (401, 403, 4xx, 5xx)

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (usuario, ip, metodo, rota, status) (count_over_time({type="audit"} | json msg="message", ip="ip", usuario="user" | line_format `{{.msg}}` | regexp `^\S+ \| (?P<metodo>[A-Z]+) (?P<rota>\S+) \| (?P<status>\d+) \| (?P<ms>\d+)ms` | __error__="" | usuario=~`(?i).*${usuario}.*` | ip=~`.*${ip}.*` | status >= 400 [$__range])))

panels.title: Registro de auditoria (usuário · IP · método rota · status · tempo)

targets.expr: {type="audit"} | json msg="message", ip="ip", usuario="user", requestId="requestId" | line_format `{{.msg}}` | regexp `^\S+ \| (?P<metodo>[A-Z]+) (?P<rota>\S+) \| (?P<status>\d+) \| (?P<ms>\d+)ms` | __error__="" | usuario=~`(?i).*${usuario}.*` | ip=~`.*${ip}.*` | status=~`${status}` | line_format `{{.usuario}} · {{.ip}} · {{.metodo}} {{.rota}} · {{.status}} · {{.ms}} ms`
